title: be going to (~할 거야, 계획)
goal: be going to로 이미 정해 둔 계획을 말하고, 상대의 계획을 물어볼 수 있어요.

points.title: be going to = 정해 둔 계획
points.body: be going to + 동사원형은 '~할 거예요'라는 뜻이에요. 말하기 전에 이미 마음먹은 계획을 말할 때 써요.

points.title: be동사는 주어에 맞게
points.body: I는 am, he / she / it은 is, you / we / they는 are를 써요. 줄여서 I'm going to, She's going to, We're going to처럼 말해요.

points.title: to 뒤에는 동사원형
points.body: going to 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 와요. She is going to visit (O), She is going to visits (X).

points.title: 부정문과 질문
points.body: 부정은 be동사 뒤에 not: I'm not going to ~, He isn't going to ~. 질문은 be동사를 앞으로: Are you going to ~? 대답은 Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

points.title: will과 뭐가 달라요?
points.body: 그 자리에서 바로 정하면 will("I'll have a latte."), 미리 정한 계획이면 be going to("I'm going to apply for a job.")를 주로 써요. 눈앞에 보이는 걸로 '곧 ~하겠다' 할 때도 be going to를 써요. (It's going to rain.)

formula: He / She / It + is + going to + 동사원형
You / We / They + are + going to + 동사원형
Am / Is / Are + 주어 + going to + 동사원형 ~?

mistakes.wrong: I going to buy a car.
mistakes.right: I'm going to buy a car.
mistakes.why: 한국어에는 be동사에 해당하는 말이 없어서 자주 빠뜨려요. going to 앞에 am / is / are를 꼭 넣으세요.

mistakes.wrong: She is going to visits Sydney.
mistakes.right: She is going to visit Sydney.
mistakes.why: 주어가 She라도 to 뒤에는 동사원형이에요. -s를 붙이지 마세요.

mistakes.wrong: Do you going to cook tonight?
mistakes.right: Are you going to cook tonight?
mistakes.why: be going to의 질문은 do가 아니라 be동사(Are)를 앞으로 보내요.

examples.en: I'm going to apply for a barista job.
She's going to move to Melbourne next month.
examples.ko: 그녀는 다음 달에 멜버른으로 이사할 거예요.

examples.en: We're going to have a barbecue this weekend.
examples.ko: 우리는 이번 주말에 바비큐를 할 거예요.

examples.en: They're going to work on a farm in Queensland.
examples.ko: 그들은 퀸즐랜드에 있는 농장에서 일할 거예요.

examples.en: I'm not going to eat out this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에는 외식 안 할 거예요.

examples.en: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
examples.ko: 저 구름 좀 봐요. 비가 오겠어요.

examples.en: "Are you going to cook tonight?" "Yes, I am."
What are you going to do on Saturday?

quiz.sentence: I ___ going to buy a bike.
Tom is going to ___ his room tonight.
quiz.ko: Tom은 오늘 밤에 방을 청소할 거예요.
quiz.why: going to 뒤에는 동사원형 clean. to를 또 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.sentence: We ___ going to watch a movie tonight.
quiz.ko: 우리는 오늘 밤에 영화를 볼 거예요.

quiz.sentence: He ___ going to come to the party.
quiz.why: 부정은 be동사 + not. He는 is니까 isn't.

quiz.sentence: ___ they going to stay in Sydney?
quiz.why: 질문은 be동사를 앞으로. They는 are니까 Are.

quiz.answer: I'm going to have a job interview tomorrow.
choices: I'm going to have a job interview tomorrow.
I'm going to has a job interview tomorrow.
I going to have a job interview tomorrow.
I'm going have a job interview tomorrow.
quiz.why: I'm + going to + 동사원형 have. am과 to 둘 다 빠지면 안 돼요.

quiz.ko: 우리는 다음 주에 이사 안 할 거예요.
quiz.answer: We aren't going to move next week.
choices: We aren't going to move next week.
We don't going to move next week.
We aren't going to moving next week.
We aren't go to move next week.
quiz.why: 부정은 aren't going to + 동사원형 move.

quiz.answer: Are you going to cook tonight?
choices: Are you going to cook tonight?
Do you going to cook tonight?
Are you going to cooking tonight?
quiz.why: 질문은 Are you going to + 동사원형 ~?
눈앞에 보이는 걸로 예측할 때 It's going to + 동사원형.

quiz.answer: She is going to visit her friend in Perth.
choices: She is going to visit her friend in Perth.
She is going to visits her friend in Perth.
She going to visit her friend in Perth.
She are going to visit her friend in Perth.
quiz.why: She + is + going to + 동사원형 visit.

quiz.answer: They are going to start work at 7.
choices: They are going to start work at 7.
They is going to start work at 7.
They are going to started work at 7.
They going to start work at 7.
quiz.why: They는 are, to 뒤에는 동사원형 start.

quiz.prompt: "Is he going to call you?"에 맞는 대답을 고르세요.
quiz.why: Is로 물으면 is로 대답해요. Yes, he is.
